hardware.tested_state: active review followed by rejected serial request

procedure: Built the T-Display S3 firmware with ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh.
Ran the default USB serial smoke suite with 33 verified exchanges.
Reset the board and sent a valid serial sign_event request so the display entered a live trusted-review session.
Sent an invalid serial request while the trusted-review session was active.
Observed the terminal request-error display state on the physical T-Display S3.
expected_result: A rejected serial request during an active review clears the RAM-only review session, shows Request Error / Rejected / Not signed / Signing disabled / Send new request, and the protocol still returns a deterministic error frame.
observed_result: Manual physical confirmation showed Request Error / Rejected / Not signed / Signing disabled / Send new request after an invalid serial request was sent during an active review. The clean ef272e5 firmware build passed 33 USB serial smoke exchanges, and sign_event remained signing_disabled.
limitations: This validates display-state cleanup for rejected serial requests only; it is not production signing acceptance.
The request-error frame clears the RAM-only review session but does not authorize or execute signing.
The protocol response for sign_event remains signing_disabled.
No persistent key custody, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, enclosure, or production approval policy was validated.
